# firstboot_network (Resource)

A private network. Servers that join it reach each other on private addresses.

**The API has no update for a network at all**, so every attribute here requires replacement. That is a real constraint rather than a provider limitation: a CIDR change would strand every member's address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) The private range, e.g. `10.10.0.0/24`. Servers already referencing the network wait for it: provisioning does not race it.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Optional project to group the network under. Changing it moves the network in place; it is not a replacement.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on this network, used to select it from a `firstboot_*` data source and to filter it in the panel.

At most 10, each up to 32 characters of `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, `:` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit. `env:prod` is a convention, not a schema: a tag is one flat string.

**Written exactly as given.** The API stores tags lowercased, so a tag that is not already lowercase is refused at plan time rather than silently rewritten — a rewritten value would differ from the configuration on every subsequent plan.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String) `active` or `error` are settled; `creating` and `deleting` are in flight.
